pyq_audit.status: Exact wording is retained where held; neutral routed wording and doctrinal solutions are labelled when official keys/models are unavailable.

current_affairs_audit.fact: NCSC, NCST, NCBC, Legislative Department and Supreme Court official sources were rechecked on 24 August 2026. No later constitutional amendment changing Articles 338, 338A, 338B, 341, 342 or 342A is asserted.
current_affairs_audit.caveat: Civil-court powers are evidentiary powers during inquiry, not ordinary court jurisdiction. Davinder Singh (2024) permits evidence-based SC sub-classification without altering the Presidential List; separate creamy-layer observations are not presented as one unanimous exclusion rule.
